checks: Equal NPC/player velocity depenetrates with zero collision impulse
Rear-end response uses player-minus-NPC closing velocity
Approaching NPC pushes stationary player and separating NPC has no false impulse
Oncoming traffic uses combined relative speed
Normal and friction impulses are invariant under common translation velocity
Missing or non-finite NPC velocity preserves static response exactly
Original static collision suite remains unchanged
limits: NPCs are kinematic obstacles. Player energy can increase in the world frame when an NPC pushes it; energy is checked in the NPC frame.
The solver uses NPC linear velocity at contact and does not implement equal-mass rigid-body exchanges or swept NPC trajectories.
